title: Identify the coefficients
text: In the standard form f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c, identify a = 1, b = -6, and c = 5. The turning point formula requires a and b.

title: Apply the turning point formula
text: The x-coordinate of the turning point is given by x = -b/(2a). Substitute b = -6 and a = 1 to get x = -(-6)/(2 x 1) = 6/2 = 3.
